context.hint: Constrain every archive filesystem operation to the extraction root.
context.surface: An extractor accepts archive entries and may create files, directories, links, or metadata.
assumptions: Use a temporary extraction root and a separate benign sibling fixture.

review.invariant: Links and filesystem operations observe whole-component containment and the documented link policy.
review.verification: Inspect each link and entry write path. Verify a supported in-root link and check a denial at the filesystem boundary.

source_observation.summary: The local tests showed that path-component containment was necessary for the entry and link paths.
